note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1958. Nominations 20 May 1958; two withdrawals (Ballybot, Killeen); six contests, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No nomination for Moyra Castle, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. Polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Trainor was the outgoing member. Richardson, M.P., announced his withdrawal after the deadline, so the poll went ahead; he forfeited his deposit. Earlier transcription: Richardson, M.P. for South Armagh, announced his withdrawal on 27 May, too late to be removed from the ballot, and forfeited his deposit.
